name: managing-risk-adjustment-coding
description: Reviews Medicare Advantage CMS-HCC and ACA HHS-HCC risk adjustment coding for documentation support and RADV audit readiness. Validates each submitted or proposed ICD-10-CM diagnosis against the face-to-face encounter note, acceptable data source and provider type, telehealth rules (audio-video only for MA), signature and credentials, and the data collection period; applies ICD-10-CM Section IV outpatient rules, history-of rules for cancer and stroke, and the 2024 CMS-HCC model (V28) with its hierarchies. Runs two-way retrospective chart reviews that delete unsupported codes as well as add supported ones, builds HCC and RAF impact tables and RADV support packets, and redesigns recapture and suspect-list prompts so providers evaluate rather than confirm. Use for HCC coding audit, RAF score validation, chart review, RADV preparation, V24 to V28 transition, MEAT or TAMPER documentation, unlinked chart review records, or HCC recapture. Drafts for coder, CDI and compliance review; never codes from problem lists.
